goal: Port a Lua 5.4 snippet (goto, bitwise operators) to valid Luau with identical results
prompt:
Port this Lua 5.4 function to Luau so it runs in Roblox and returns the same three values.

local function pack(flags)
  local out = 0
  for i = 1, #flags do
    if not flags[i] then goto continue end
    out = out | (1 << (i - 1))
    ::continue::
  end
  return out, out // 4, out >> 1
end
return pack
